mapper.sql: b.id, b.system_id, b.database_id, b.db_user, b.title, b.source_type, b.source_ref, b.table_count, b.added_count, b.updated_count, b.unchanged_count, b.missing_count, b.created_by, b.create_time, b.update_time, s.system_name AS system_name, (SELECT u.real_name FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = b.created_by) AS created_by_name

where.if: AND (b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.db_user LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_doc (system_id, database_id, db_user, title, source_type, source_ref, source_sql, parsed_json, table_count, added_count, updated_count, unchanged_count, missing_count, created_by) VALUES (#{systemId}, #{databaseId}, #{dbUser}, #{title}, IFNULL(#{sourceType}, 'DDL'), #{sourceRef}, #{sourceSql}, #{parsedJson}, #{tableCount}, #{addedCount}, #{updatedCount}, #{unchangedCount}, #{missingCount}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, s.system_name AS system_name, (SELECT u.real_name FROM `user` u WHERE u.id = b.created_by) AS created_by_name FROM db_doc b LEFT JOIN db_system s ON s.id = b.system_id WHERE b.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM db_doc b LEFT JOIN db_system s ON s.id = b.system_id
ORDER BY b.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE db_doc SET table_count = #{tableCount}, added_count = #{addedCount}, updated_count = #{updatedCount}, unchanged_count = #{unchangedCount}, missing_count = #{missingCount} WHERE id = #{id}
